items.docs: This API fetches the name of the field set as the default field for account deduplication.

info.name: Set default field for account deduplication

items.docs: This API sets the field you specify as the default field for deduplicating accounts.

params.name: fieldName
params.description: Name of the field whose values must be matched for deduplication.Values allowed are: !@email,@! !@phone,@! and !@accountName@!

params.name: swFieldValue
params.description: Key that specifies the letter with which the field values must start

params.name: from
params.description: Index number starting from which the accounts must be fetched

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Key that sorts the accounts by a specific attribute: @count@ or @fieldValue@. The default sorting order is ascending. A @-@ prefix denotes descending order of sorting.

items.docs:
This API lists the duplicate entries of an account.The _fieldName_ parameters is mandatory in the API request

_Note:_
If you encounter a 202 status code while executing this API request, it means there are 100,000 or more accounts in the help desk portal. Matching the records and finding duplicates will be time-consuming in such a scenario. Therefore, the deduplication request will be accepted, and after the process is completed, an automated report will be sent to the user who

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Key that sorts the accounts by a specific attribute: @accountName@ or @createdTime@ or @modifiedTime@. The default sorting order is ascending. A @-@ prefix denotes descending order of sorting.

params.description: Index number starting from which the accounts must be fetched

params.name: fieldValues
params.description: Actual values in each field related to the account

items.docs: This API lists all the details of duplicate accounts.The _fieldName_ and _fieldValues_ parameters are mandatory in the API request
